items.summary: Guelph Solar - Island Foods and Solar Open House
items.description: https://www.meetup.com/Guelph-Solar-Open-House-Meetup/events/238592227/ Guelph Solar Open House Island foods and Solar Open House Saturday, April 22, 2017 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM Jen and Mark Colvin's Home 49 Caledonia St., Guelph, ON Knock on the door, we will be inside! Come out to this fun sunshine and island themed Solar Open House! With the intention of calling on more sun we will be offering yummy Jamaican foods, and drinks!! Our hosts, Mark & Jen Colvin have had their solar microFit install for several years and also have a solar water heating system. They're excited to open up their home to share their solar experiences. The microFIT program is expected to end in 2017. If you've been considering solar, NOW is the time! Take the time to discover if your roof has solar potential. We will be able to assess via mobile decives on site. Tell your friends and family! This will be a great opportunity to learn about solar and have some yummy foods.

items.description:
http://kwarc.org/kwarc-meet.html

Kitchener Waterloo Amateur Radio Club

MEETING DATES
KWARC holds regular meetings September to June on the first Monday of each month. On those months where the first Monday is a Statutory Holiday, meeting are convened on the following Monday.

MEETING LOCATION
Meetings commence at 7:30PM in the 404 WING Club at the end of Dutton Drive in Waterloo. Dutton is North off Weber between Albert Street and the Railway overpass. Click here for map

The 404 Wing building provides ground level access for mobility challenged individuals. Our agenda will commence with a brief welcome followed by the featured speaker. The business session will follow a 20 minute coffee and donut "eye-ball" session.
